name: Airline Contract Intelligence
description: Extract structured rate card data from airline service agreements — ground handling, catering, cargo, security, ULD management. Supports multi-page table extraction, rate normalization, and contract comparison.

fields.name: contract_name
fields.label: Contract Name
fields.description: Full contract title or agreement name

fields.name: contract_number
fields.label: Contract Number
fields.description: Contract reference or agreement number

fields.name: category
fields.label: Service Category
fields.description: Top-level category: Ground Handling, Catering, Cargo, Security, Fuel, Airport Charges, ULD, Lounge

fields.name: vendor
fields.label: Vendor / Service Provider
fields.description: Vendor code or company name (e.g., SATS, dnata, Swissport)

fields.name: airline
fields.label: Airline
fields.description: Airline name or IATA code

fields.name: station
fields.label: Station (IATA Code)
fields.description: Airport IATA code (e.g., SIN, DXB, LHR, JFK)

fields.name: applicable_from
fields.label: Contract Start Date
fields.description: Contract effective start date

fields.name: applicable_to
fields.label: Contract End Date
fields.description: Contract expiry or renewal date

fields.name: invoice_currency
fields.label: Invoice Currency
fields.description: Currency for invoicing (SAR, USD, EUR, SGD, etc.)

fields.name: original_contract
fields.label: Original/Predecessor Contract
fields.description: Reference to predecessor or master agreement

fields.name: services_list
fields.label: Services Covered
fields.description: All services listed in the contract

fields.name: service_count
fields.label: Number of Services
fields.description: Total count of distinct services in the contract

fields.name: suspended_services
fields.label: Suspended Services
fields.description: Services marked as suspended with effective dates

fields.name: cpi_applicable
fields.label: CPI/Inflation Adjustment
fields.description: Whether CPI escalation applies and the benchmark index

fields.name: rate_table
fields.label: Rate Table Summary
fields.description: Key rates with service name, rate value, unit, and currency

fields.name: rate_currency
fields.label: Rate Currency
fields.description: Currency used for rate definitions

fields.name: rate_basis
fields.label: Rate Basis
fields.description: How rates are calculated: per flight, per passenger, per kg, per unit, per hour, percentage

fields.name: volume_tiers
fields.label: Volume-Based Tiers
fields.description: Tiered pricing based on volume

fields.name: minimum_charges
fields.label: Minimum Charges
fields.description: Minimum guaranteed amounts or minimum quantities

fields.name: maximum_charges
fields.label: Maximum/Cap Charges
fields.description: Maximum or capped charges

fields.name: free_allowances
fields.label: Free Allowances
fields.description: Free quantities, complimentary services, included items

fields.name: aircraft_types
fields.label: Aircraft Types
fields.description: Aircraft types/categories with different rate structures (NB, WB, Code E, etc.)

fields.name: flight_types
fields.label: Flight Types
fields.description: Domestic, international, turnaround, transit, ferry, technical stop

fields.name: movement_types
fields.label: Movement Types
fields.description: Arrival, departure, turnaround, overnight

fields.name: time_based_rates
fields.label: Time-Based Conditions
fields.description: Rates varying by time (peak/off-peak, overnight, ground hours, delay charges)

fields.name: cancellation_terms
fields.label: Cancellation Terms
fields.description: Cancellation notice periods and associated charges

fields.name: tax_code
fields.label: Applicable Tax
fields.description: Tax code or VAT/GST rate applicable

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: Payment period (e.g., Net 30, Net 60)

fields.name: penalty_clauses
fields.label: Penalty Clauses
fields.description: Late payment penalties, SLA breach penalties

fields.name: sla_targets
fields.label: SLA Targets
fields.description: Service level agreement targets and KPIs

fields.name: signatories
fields.label: Contract Signatories
fields.description: Names and roles of contract signatories

fields.name: effective_date
fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date contract was signed/executed

fields.name: renewal_terms
fields.label: Renewal Terms
fields.description: Auto-renewal, notice period for termination

fields.name: governing_law
fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: Jurisdiction and governing law

fields.name: total_pages
fields.label: Total Pages
fields.description: Total pages in the contract document

fields.name: tables_found
fields.label: Rate Tables Found
fields.description: Number of rate/pricing tables extracted

fields.name: annexures
fields.label: Annexures/Schedules
fields.description: List of annexures, schedules, or appendices
